steps.name: extract
steps.description: Split the source export into one file per item

steps.name: analyze-unicode
steps.description: Inventory every non-ASCII character, for review before cleaning

steps.name: clean
steps.description: Normalise Unicode using the report from analyze-unicode

steps.name: analyze-tags
steps.description: Inventory the HTML tags present in the cleaned body field

steps.name: normalize-html
steps.description: Turn SharePoint editor HTML into semantic HTML

steps.name: convert-richtext
steps.description: Convert the normalised body HTML to Storyblok rich text

steps.name: build-link-map
steps.description: Build SharePoint URL to Storyblok story lookup map

steps.name: catalog-assets
steps.description: Catalogue the SharePoint images referenced in item bodies

steps.name: upload-assets
steps.description: Upload cataloged assets to Storyblok (requires API credentials)

steps.name: enhance-richtext
steps.description: Resolve internal story links and asset URLs in rich text JSON

steps.name: build-stories
steps.description: Build full Storyblok story payloads including PullQuote handling

steps.name: validate-media
steps.description: Validate Metadata.csv references against the media on disk

steps.name: map-storyblok-media
steps.description: Map each built story to its media files via Metadata.csv

steps.name: inject-story-media
steps.description: Inject Metadata.csv media bloks into storyblok_stories before body

steps.name: catalog-richtext-media
steps.description: Catalog PDF/image/media links in rich text missing from assets/News/media

steps.name: download-richtext-media
steps.description: Download missing rich-text media into the type's assets folders/media and update story mappings

steps.name: verify-richtext-media
steps.description: Verify rich-text media downloads and report downloaded vs missing assets

steps.name: attach-richtext-media
steps.description: Attach downloaded rich-text media into storyblok_stories body links and media bloks

steps.name: classify-story-media
steps.description: Classify stories by thumbnail, GIF, video file, and embedded video media

steps.name: validate-metadata
steps.description: Validate SharePoint metadata coverage in storyblok_stories

steps.name: extract-viewer-filters
steps.description: Extract tags, authors, publishers, and content writers for storyblok-viewer filters

steps.name: import-storyblok
steps.description: Import built stories to Storyblok via Management API
